name: Ship Straight Assist
description: When you spam-click in ship mode, the ship holds a straight line instead of bouncing around.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the assist on or off.

click-count.name: Clicks to trigger
click-count.description: How many fast clicks activate the assist.

click-window.name: Click window (seconds)
click-window.description: The clicks must happen within this time.

release-time.name: Stop delay (seconds)
release-time.description: Assist turns off this long after your last click.

strength.name: Assist strength
strength.description: 1.0 = perfectly flat line, lower = gentler help.
